/presentation.en: A 46-year-old woman presents with breathlessness and worsening weakness. She is awake and pauses between sentences.
/presentation.es: Una mujer de 46 años consulta por disnea y debilidad progresiva. Está vigil y hace pausas entre frases.

/history/chief_complaint/0.en: I feel short of breath and too weak to stand for long.
/history/chief_complaint/0.es: Me falta el aire y me siento demasiado débil para estar mucho rato de pie.

/history/associated_symptoms/0.en: I have had a cough with yellow sputum and shaking chills.
/history/associated_symptoms/0.es: He tenido tos con expectoración amarilla y escalofríos con temblor.

/history/associated_symptoms/1.en: It hurts on the right when I take a deep breath.
/history/associated_symptoms/1.es: Me duele en el lado derecho cuando respiro profundo.

/history/medical_history/0.en: I have rheumatoid arthritis; I have not previously needed oxygen.
/history/medical_history/0.es: Tengo artritis reumatoide; antes no había necesitado oxígeno.

/history/medications/0.en: I take methotrexate weekly and folic acid; no antibiotic has been started.
/history/medications/0.es: Tomo metotrexato semanal y ácido fólico; no me han iniciado ningún antibiótico.

/history/allergies/0.en: No known medication allergies are reported.
/history/allergies/0.es: No se refieren alergias medicamentosas conocidas.

/history/onset/0.en: The cough began three days ago; the breathing and weakness worsened today.
/history/onset/0.es: La tos empezó hace tres días; hoy empeoraron la respiración y la debilidad.

/history/risk_factors/0.en: I receive methotrexate and have eaten and drunk little since yesterday.
/history/risk_factors/0.es: Estoy en tratamiento con metotrexato y desde ayer he comido y tomado poco.

/history/chest_pain/0.en: The right-sided pain occurs with coughing or deep inspiration, not as a central pressure.
/history/chest_pain/0.es: El dolor del lado derecho aparece al toser o al inspirar profundo, no como una opresión central.

/history/breathing/0.en: The shortness of breath is now present while sitting still.
/history/breathing/0.es: Ahora me falta el aire estando sentada y quieta.

/history/oral_intake/0.en: I have had very little to eat or drink since yesterday.
/history/oral_intake/0.es: Desde ayer he comido y tomado muy poco.

/history/urinary_symptoms/0.en: I have no burning or frequency when passing urine.
/history/urinary_symptoms/0.es: No tengo ardor al orinar ni orino más seguido.

/history/bleeding/0.en: I have not coughed blood, vomited blood or passed black stools.
/history/bleeding/0.es: No he tosido sangre, no he vomitado sangre ni he tenido deposiciones negras.

/examination/Cardiac.en: Rapid regular pulse; no new murmur heard.
/examination/Cardiac.es: Pulso rápido y regular; no se ausculta soplo nuevo.

/examination/Respiratory.en: Increased respiratory effort; focal crackles and bronchial breathing at the right base.
/examination/Respiratory.es: Esfuerzo respiratorio aumentado; crepitaciones focales y soplo tubario en la base derecha.

/examination/Abdomen.en: Soft; no focal tenderness or guarding.
/examination/Abdomen.es: Blando; sin dolor focal a la palpación ni resistencia muscular.

/examination/Neurological.en: Awake, oriented and moving all limbs symmetrically.
/examination/Neurological.es: Vigil, orientada y moviliza las cuatro extremidades en forma simétrica.

/investigations/pocus/result/rv.en: Smaller than the LV; no septal flattening (no D-sign); no McConnell sign
/investigations/pocus/result/rv.es: Menor que el VI; sin aplanamiento septal (sin signo D); sin signo de McConnell

/investigations/pocus/result/lungs.en: Focal B-lines at the right base; no diffuse bilateral B-lines
/investigations/pocus/result/lungs.es: Líneas B focales en la base derecha; sin líneas B difusas bilaterales

/investigations/pocus/result/lung_consol.en: Right basal subpleural consolidation with dynamic air bronchograms; no pleural effusion
/investigations/pocus/result/lung_consol.es: Consolidación subpleural basal derecha con broncogramas aéreos dinámicos; sin derrame pleural

/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_desce.en: Not dilated in the visible segment
/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_desce.es: No dilatada en el segmento visible

/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_abdom.en: Normal calibre from the diaphragm to the iliac bifurcation
/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_abdom.es: Calibre normal desde el diafragma hasta la bifurcación ilíaca

/investigations/chest_xray/result/report.en: Right lower-lobe air-space opacity. No pulmonary edema or pneumothorax.
/investigations/chest_xray/result/report.es: Opacidad alveolar en el lóbulo inferior derecho. Sin edema pulmonar ni neumotórax.

/investigations/troponin/result/report.en: Single sample; interpret with symptoms and ECG. Serial testing requires a new sample.
/investigations/troponin/result/report.es: Muestra única; interpretar junto con los síntomas y el ECG. La medición seriada requiere una nueva muestra.

/investigations/urinalysis/result/report.en: No leukocyte esterase, nitrite or blood detected.
/investigations/urinalysis/result/report.es: No se detectan esterasa leucocitaria, nitritos ni sangre.

/investigations/blood_cultures/result/re.en: Samples collected; culture identification and susceptibility results are pending.
/investigations/blood_cultures/result/re.es: Muestras tomadas; los resultados de identificación y susceptibilidad del cultivo están pendientes.

/presentation.en: An 83-year-old man is brought by his daughter after becoming unusually sleepy and nearly falling at home. The referral note suggests possible dehydration after poor intake; no diagnosis has been established.
/presentation.es: Un hombre de 83 años es traído por su hija tras presentar una somnolencia inusual y estar a punto de caerse en casa. La nota de derivación sugiere una posible deshidratación tras una baja ingesta; no se ha establecido ningún diagnóstico.

/history/chief_complaint/0.en: His daughter reports that he has become sleepy and much less steady on his feet.
/history/chief_complaint/0.es: Su hija refiere que se ha puesto somnoliento y mucho menos estable de pie.

/history/associated_symptoms/0.en: His daughter noticed a new cough and reduced appetite over two days.
/history/associated_symptoms/0.es: Su hija notó una tos nueva y disminución del apetito en los últimos dos días.

/history/associated_symptoms/1.en: He has been breathing faster today.
/history/associated_symptoms/1.es: Hoy ha estado respirando más rápido.

/history/medical_history/0.en: His daughter reports hypertension and hearing impairment; he normally walks independently and converses clearly.
/history/medical_history/0.es: Su hija refiere hipertensión e hipoacusia; habitualmente camina sin ayuda y conversa con claridad.

/history/medications/0.en: His daughter lists amlodipine as his only regular prescription.
/history/medications/0.es: Su hija menciona amlodipino como su único medicamento recetado de uso habitual.

/history/allergies/0.en: No known medication allergies are reported.
/history/allergies/0.es: No se refieren alergias medicamentosas conocidas.

/history/onset/0.en: The cough began two days ago; sleepiness and near-fall occurred this morning.
/history/onset/0.es: La tos empezó hace dos días; la somnolencia y la casi caída ocurrieron esta mañana.

/history/risk_factors/0.en: He is independently mobile at baseline and has had poor oral intake during this illness.
/history/risk_factors/0.es: En su estado basal se moviliza en forma independiente y durante este cuadro ha tenido una baja ingesta oral.

/history/breathing/0.en: His daughter says the faster breathing began before the near-fall.
/history/breathing/0.es: Su hija cuenta que la respiración rápida empezó antes de la casi caída.

/history/oral_intake/0.en: His daughter says he has taken only small sips and little food today.
/history/oral_intake/0.es: Su hija cuenta que hoy solo ha tomado pequeños sorbos y ha comido poco.

/history/exposure/0.en: There was no witnessed head strike, seizure or new sedative exposure.
/history/exposure/0.es: No se presenció golpe en la cabeza, convulsión ni exposición a un sedante nuevo.

/history/urinary_symptoms/0.en: His daughter reports no preceding urinary complaints.
/history/urinary_symptoms/0.es: Su hija no refiere molestias urinarias previas.

/examination/Cardiac.en: Rapid regular pulse; no new murmur heard.
/examination/Cardiac.es: Pulso rápido y regular; no se ausculta soplo nuevo.

/examination/Respiratory.en: Tachypnea with focal crackles and reduced air entry at the left base.
/examination/Respiratory.es: Taquipnea con crepitaciones focales y murmullo pulmonar disminuido en la base izquierda.

/examination/Abdomen.en: Soft and non-tender; no suprapubic tenderness.
/examination/Abdomen.es: Blando e indoloro; sin dolor suprapúbico a la palpación.

/examination/Neurological.en: Opens eyes to voice, follows simple commands slowly, and moves all limbs without an obvious focal deficit.
/examination/Neurological.es: Abre los ojos al estímulo verbal, obedece órdenes simples con lentitud y moviliza las cuatro extremidades sin déficit focal evidente.

/investigations/pocus/result/rv.en: Smaller than the LV; no septal flattening (no D-sign); no McConnell sign
/investigations/pocus/result/rv.es: Menor que el VI; sin aplanamiento septal (sin signo D); sin signo de McConnell

/investigations/pocus/result/lungs.en: Focal B-lines at the left base; no diffuse bilateral B-lines
/investigations/pocus/result/lungs.es: Líneas B focales en la base izquierda; sin líneas B difusas bilaterales

/investigations/pocus/result/lung_consol.en: Left basal consolidation with air bronchograms; no pleural effusion
/investigations/pocus/result/lung_consol.es: Consolidación basal izquierda con broncogramas aéreos; sin derrame pleural

/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_desce.en: Not dilated in the visible segment
/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_desce.es: No dilatada en el segmento visible

/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_abdom.en: Normal calibre from the diaphragm to the iliac bifurcation
/investigations/pocus/result/aorta_abdom.es: Calibre normal desde el diafragma hasta la bifurcación ilíaca

/investigations/chest_xray/result/report.en: Left lower-lobe consolidation without diffuse edema.
/investigations/chest_xray/result/report.es: Consolidación en el lóbulo inferior izquierdo sin edema difuso.

/investigations/troponin/result/report.en: Single sample; interpret with symptoms and ECG. Serial testing requires a new sample.
/investigations/troponin/result/report.es: Muestra única; interpretar junto con los síntomas y el ECG. La medición seriada requiere una nueva muestra.

/investigations/urinalysis/result/report.en: No leukocyte esterase, nitrite or blood detected.
/investigations/urinalysis/result/report.es: No se detectan esterasa leucocitaria, nitritos ni sangre.

/investigations/blood_cultures/result/re.en: Samples collected; culture identification and susceptibility results are pending.
/investigations/blood_cultures/result/re.es: Muestras tomadas; los resultados de identificación y susceptibilidad del cultivo están pendientes.
